text:
Maya: Quick status check — ingest for three new open models (sirius-7b, polaris-3b, orion13b) is in flight.
Maya: Blocking items: legal flag on polaris (possible non-commercial clause), perf profile for orion13b OOMs on the default G4dn runner. PR is up for registry changes: https://github.com/redwood/model-registry/pull/452
Dan: Thanks — assigned. I can own ingest fixes. Lee, can you take perf for orion?
Lee: I can pick it up tomorrow morning (OOO rest of today). I kicked off a trimmed profile run with seq_len=512, batch=1 to repro. Log excerpt:
```
[run_24] step=72 ERROR OOM device=0 rss=14.2GB kernel=attention_cu
```
Lee: Might be a kv-cache / kernel select edge at long context.
Maya: Noted. If perf is blocked we should still ship sirius-7b to canary if it has green legal.
Rachel: Quick legal check — polaris-3b's upstream license includes a non-commercial clause (CC-BY-NC variant). We cannot surface that in hosted catalog for paid users. Need either a relicense from upstream or mark it "disallowed-hosted" and only offer private deployment.
Maya: Okay, block polaris from the hosted catalog for launch. Add to private-only backlog.
Dan: I'll add a manifest tag and update PR 452 to mark polaris as private-only.
Sam C: I'll add a gating rule to Console to surface license state (card id ML-CATALOG-LIC-7). Can someone paste the exact license text or link?
Rachel: Link: https://models.example/upstream/polaris/license.txt — clause at section 2.b.
Dan: On orion13b perf: I tried a fallback 8-bit run (quant=8) and it completed at lower mem but latency p95 jumped ~1.8x. Leaving profiling artifacts at: https://artifacts.redwood/orion13b/profiles/run-78
Maya: We need two things: (1) perf SLO check (latency/cost tradeoffs) and (2) eval diff on quality for 4-bit vs 8-bit. Dan/Lee, can you create a short eval seed set and link results here?
Dan: Yep — creating eval issue #99 with seeds and baseline prompts. Will link when ready.
Lee: If kernel selection is the cause I can try forcing an alternative attention kernel and re-run a microprofile. ETA tomorrow AM.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy-check: model-runtime patch v0.9.3 promoted to staging (sha: a1b2c3). No runtime changes expected to affect profiling jobs.
Maya: Small ask — PR 452 needs one more reviewer for the manifest change (license tag + canary list). @Lee or @Sam C can you do a quick CR? It's mostly YAML.
Sam C: I can review in ~45m.
Lee: Will review tomorrow morning and leave comments if anything pops.
Maya: Plan summary — sirius-7b -> canary (if legal ok), orion13b -> perf gating (Dan/Lee to finish microprofiles & evals), polaris-3b -> blocked for hosted (legal), mark as private-only. Action items: Dan update PR + eval issue (#99), Lee run kernel microprofile tomorrow AM, Sam add gating card to Console, Rachel file license note in catalog schema.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll update the catalog manifest once PR lands and drop a short launch checklist in the registry board. :thumbsup:
Dan: ETA EOD for PR update.
Sam C: Done — added gating card draft and linked PR 452.
Rachel: I'll create a formal legal note for the catalog entry by EOD PDT.
Maya: Closing loop — ping me if anything blocks.
